description: This file defines a React component for the ExploreClient page in a career navigator web application. It manages search, filters, view modes (cards or mindmap), and renders various subcomponents for user interaction and display of search results or recommendations.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined inputs.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses salary range data from a role object and returns min and max salary in lakhs.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts the role title from a role object.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role matches the current search filters and query.

methods.name: ExploreClient
methods.description: Main React component managing the explore page, including state, effects, and rendering logic.
